title: Migrate nested configuration paths atomically
instruction: Complete rename_config(config, rules, version) as an atomic nested configuration migration. config and rules are mappings; config has an exact positive integer version lower than the target positive integer version. rules maps dotted identifier paths to dotted identifier paths. Reject empty, duplicate, overlapping ancestor/descendant, missing-source, existing-target, or non-mapping-parent paths before mutation. Move every value from the original snapshot, create missing mapping parents only, deep-copy all returned containers, set the target version, and never mutate caller data. Any failure must produce no partial result or caller mutation. Add tests and no dependencies.

author_metadata.notes: Wave-4 configuration lineage using nested path moves, collision detection, and atomic migration.
